newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Sacremento USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Sacramento City Unified School District (the School District'') intends to receive sealed bids on or after

(as such date may be established by the Chief Financial Officer of the School District and communicated through Munifacts News Services not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be received) at the hour of 10:00 a.m., California time, at the offices of Orrick, Herrington &Sutcliffe LLP, 400 Sansome Street, Second Floor, Conference Room A, San Francisco, California 94111, for the above Bonds dated November 1, 1996. Mailed bids should be addressed to the Chief Financial Officer of the School District in care of Orrick, Herrington &Sutcliffe LLP at the above address, or by Fax to (415) 773-5759. All bids must be clearly marked Proposal for the Sacramento City Unified School District, Community Facilities District No. 1, Special Tax Bonds, Series C (Refunding).''
Copies of the Official Statement and the Official Notice of Sale may be obtained from the School District's financial advisor by telephone or fax request:
Secretary of the Sacramento City Unified School District
